methods.title: Create empty grand room with no furniture
methods.prompt: An empty grand room with no furniture, no lamps, no decorative objects, no people. Keep all architectural elements: grey-blue painted raised wood panel walls with ornate molding detail, elaborate plaster ceiling cornice with leaf and bead detailing, central open doorway architrave trimmed with thick layered grey marble molding with deep red-burgundy veining as shown in reference. All wall panels are solid grey-blue painted wood — no mirrors, no reflective surfaces on walls. Right side wall panels are fully solid painted grey-blue, no glass, no mirror inserts. No radiator anywhere in the room. Polished stone floor with dark marble border inlay running along the base of the walls. Through the open doorway a second bright empty room is visible with tall windows and warm light. Room is completely empty of all objects. Photorealistic interior photography.
